name: Style Me Girl
storyline: A girl works her way up as a stylist in the fictional city of meTropolis with the help of partner/boss Eva and friend and associate Stella. She garners fame until she is renowned even in the fictional town of Glamourwood, for her prowess as a stylist to the stars.
summary: SummaryFashion stunning looks, dressup glamorous models and become the stylist to the stars in the first 3D FASHION GAME on iOS!
